rooms.name: Mount Baratok
rooms.desc: The pines thin as the slope steepens toward the mountain's bare shoulders; the going is all loose rock and broken ground. Below, the valley lies drowned in fog, and storm clouds boil overhead. Some sixty feet off, an elk stands on a jutting spur of rock.
rooms.dm: Rocky slope: difficult terrain. Even the wolves avoid this neck of the woods. The encounter can happen anywhere along the mountain's base. If the party cures the Mad Mage he leads them up to his mansion; if the card reading names him their ally he helps against Strahd, otherwise he leaves to seek his staff and spellbook after granting each a charm of heroism.

objects.label: Rocky spur
objects.desc: A spur of rock juts from the slope, flat-topped, twelve feet up.

objects.label: Elk (the Mad Mage, polymorphed)
objects.dm: The Mad Mage in elk form (polymorph). When he feels watched he resumes his own shape; swap in the hidden Mad Mage.

objects.label: The Mad Mage of Mount Baratok (archmage; Mordenkainen)
objects.playerLabel: A wild-eyed man in black robes
objects.dm: Archmage (spell list p.39; mage armor, polymorph, magnificent mansion and mind blank already cast). Paranoid: attacks on sight; at 50 hp or fewer he tries to escape. Mind blank (3d6 hours left) defeats greater restoration; DC 15 Persuasion gets him to explain, DC 18 Arcana deduces it.

objects.label: Invisible doorway to the Mad Mage's magnificent mansion
objects.dm: Restored to his wits, he leads the party here: food and safe rest, undisturbed. Mordenkainen's magnificent mansion.

objects.label: The fog below
objects.desc: You have climbed out of the fog; it lies below you now, filling the valley.

objects.label: Once noticed, the elk turns into a ragged, wild-haired man in black robes, his eyes sparking with magic.
